quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because cyclists may be present.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. You must follow its rules. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: This sign warns you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign appears a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions ahead. This sign warns you that there are traffic lights at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does a green downward arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that there is low clearance ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show a sharp curve in the direction of the arrow. This sign points left, so the road curves left. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming. Be ready for red, yellow, or green lights and watch for other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location. Turning right here is unsafe and against the law.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to watch for a side road crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this white sign mean?

options.text: The crossing is controlled. Keep your normal speed.
Look and listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
Stop at the tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look and listen, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let any trains pass before you cross.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the overpass ahead is low. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
A divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
The road winds ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you an intersection is coming. Be ready for other traffic or to turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is beginning. Stay to the right of the center divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you of two-way traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign means the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign always means "Stop."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that pedestrians may be crossing. Stop and wait until pedestrians clear the crosswalk before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and prevent brake damage.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means "Stop." Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue through or exit the freeway from your current lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane will become an exit ramp. If you are under this sign, you can change lanes to continue on the highway, or you must exit.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A circular sign warns of an upcoming railroad crossing. Watch for trains.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. If you see this sign ahead, traffic is coming toward you. Turn around.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds. This sign warns that wet pavement may be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check only for vehicles in the direction you plan to go, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and check all directions before going.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a crosswalk. Watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: You must drive in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to merge with traffic entering your lane.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic will merge into your lane from the right. Be ready to let them in safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for other traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely merge into traffic.
Traffic is merging from another road. You should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging from another road. Give them space to safely merge into traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to let merging drivers pass safely.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign (yellow with black markings). It tells you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop or turn left or right.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross safely. Pay close attention at intersections and when turning, as children may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right. Do not make a right turn at intersections with this sign.

questions.question: What do orange background signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs are only used for construction and maintenance work zones.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are bad. Always adjust your speed for weather and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right go first.
Let traffic cross before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic cross before you go.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go. Stop if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means no right turns at this location.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Drivers can use hand signals instead of or with turn signals. When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and points downward, it means they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other vehicles are coming.
Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: An octagonal (8-sided) sign always means stop. Stop at the marked line. If there is no line, stop before the crosswalk. If there is no crosswalk, stop before the intersection. Only proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that they are leaving a divided roadway and entering a two-way highway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming and they should be ready to stop completely.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: The stop sign is the only 8-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not proceed until the intersection is clear and it is safe to pass through.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers about a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid brake damage or crashes.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It means you must not continue driving in your current direction.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic can only go in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers of work zones. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance is happening ahead. Slow down and drive carefully in work areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead. Be alert and ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to road conditions. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to avoid losing control and to protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement is slippery and dangerous. Slow down when you see wet roads because your vehicle will need more time to stop.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves.
There is a sharp curve in the road ahead.
The road ahead may be slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead may be slippery.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may become slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one. Be ready to move into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals tell other drivers your intentions. When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it means you plan to turn right or move to the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left. It is unsafe and against the law to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that pedestrians cross here.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn drivers about hazards ahead. Round signs warn only about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks can use the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge ahead at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that an upcoming bridge is too narrow to safely pass trucks. Be careful.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: When you see this yellow sign, you should:

options.text: Stop until a crossing guard signals you to go.
Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop if children are in the crosswalk.
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign means you are near a school. Watch for children and be ready to stop if they are crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if needed, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if needed, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means yield. Slow down when you see it and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and do not use your brakes.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means left turns are prohibited.

questions.question: This is the shape and color of a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: A triangle pointing down is a yield sign. Slow down and stop if needed. If you stop, do so at a marked stop line if one exists.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you the road curves ahead. Slow down and drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign warns that an island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: When you see this road sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign means a divided highway is starting. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round yellow sign means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn you about?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. You must be ready to slow down or stop when you see this sign.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Speed up to prevent traffic congestion.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make space for vehicles entering. If no one is next to you, move to another lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this red and white sign?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic from both directions before going.
Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
Keep a steady speed and check for traffic from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let traffic on the road you want to enter or cross go first.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means you must slow down and be ready to stop so that other vehicles, cyclists, or pedestrians can pass. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. You might see a change in traffic direction, a steep downgrade, or another danger that needs your attention.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead turns sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic light is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead splits into two one-way roads separated by a divider. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that another road joins from the right at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?

options.text: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
The maximum legal height of a vehicle allowed in this state.
The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on the highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The distance from road surface to a bridge or overpass.
questions.explanation: This low clearance sign shows the height from the road to the bottom of a bridge or overpass (for example, 12 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: This white sign means you cannot pass other vehicles:

options.text: Until after you pass the sign.
Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: A white rectangular sign shows a rule you must follow. This sign means do not pass other vehicles under any circumstances.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to keep right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Go again when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter this road or driveway from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What should you do at a school crossing sign?

options.text: Always stop, whether there is a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs warn you about school zones and crossings. Be alert and ready to stop when you see them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you about the road ahead?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves right, then curves left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you the traffic rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What is this symbol used for?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on the back of a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see this on farm equipment, roadwork vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It appears as a solid orange triangle during the day and a hollow red triangle at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell you traffic rules. This sign means when turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What message is on this yellow pennant-shaped sign?
questions.explanation: Yellow pennant-shaped signs warn drivers of a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns that the divided highway ends ahead. Be ready to change lanes or adjust your position.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black letters or symbols. They tell drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane is ending and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. They alert you to conditions right ahead. This sign warns that the number of lanes is decreasing and drivers should merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Start to slow down when you see this warning sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Pentagonal signs show that you are in or near a school zone or school crossing. Watch for children and follow the posted speed limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds with a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and stay farther back from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A flagger is a person controlling traffic in a construction area. This sign warns you that one is ahead.

questions.question: What does this yellow sign mean?

options.text: There is a sharp turn to the right.
A right turn is permitted on a green arrow only.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a sharp turn to the right.
questions.explanation: Yellow-green warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign warns you of a sharp right turn coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A round sign always means a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: A five-sided sign is a:

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn of school zones. They tell drivers that children or other pedestrians may be crossing nearby.

questions.question: An orange and red triangle on a vehicle always means:
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter. It is posted on one-way streets and on expressway ramps where traffic flows in the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign tells you that traffic will merge from the right, so be ready to allow them in safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert you to conditions ahead. This sign means the right lane is ending and traffic will merge, so be prepared.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is only for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This is a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane sign. HOV lanes are for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign warns that a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for people with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill section of road coming up.

questions.question: You see this sign for a railroad crossing with no signal. You should:

options.text: Keep going at the same speed while looking and listening for trains.
Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, look both ways, listen for trains, and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: At this type of crossing, slow down and look both ways. Listen for trains. Be ready to stop if you see or hear a train coming. Never try to race a train across the tracks.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A construction worker with a flag is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a flagger ahead. Always follow the flagger's directions. Flaggers wear bright orange, yellow, or yellow-green clothing. They use paddles and red flags to guide traffic through work zones and to help workers cross the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards. This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet. Drive carefully in wet conditions.

questions.question: Blue traffic signs give information about:
questions.explanation: Blue signs provide information about services available to drivers. These include rest areas, food, gas stations, and hospitals.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns you that you are leaving a one-way highway and will soon drive on a two-way highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp turn is ahead. Slow down.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming and you should reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging from the right.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for bicycles crossing the road.

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A 35 mph speed zone starts after the curve.
Drive at least 35 mph around the upcoming curve.
Drive 35 mph or slower around the upcoming curve.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to conditions ahead. Some warning signs have speed plaques that show the safe speed for the hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The maximum safe speed in a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed in a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum safe speed to exit a highway. In this example, the safe speed is 30 mph.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street going the wrong way.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way. You could have a head-on collision. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
There is a detour to the right due to road construction.
The road ahead has a sharp turn at an extreme angle.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has a sharp turn at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to immediate hazards. This sign warns you to slow down for a sharp turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign means pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead. Be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a stop sign is coming up ahead. Be ready to stop.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is eight-sided. You must come to a complete stop. Look both ways for pedestrians and other vehicles before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street in the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic.

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead meets a divided highway.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to let other traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It tells you that the road ahead has a curve to the right followed by a curve to the left.

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the hill ahead.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downgrade is coming. Check your brakes before going down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road direction changes or gets narrower ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road direction changes or gets narrower ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will change direction or become narrower. You may see these signs on sharp curves or before narrow bridges.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what is the biggest concern?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher.

You may lose control if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the shoulder, do not slam the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and give the right-of-way at an intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: A railroad crossing is near. Get ready to stop.
You will always stop at the railroad crossing ahead.
Stop and wait for a signal before crossing the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: A railroad crossing is near. Get ready to stop.
questions.explanation: This sign means a railroad crossing is coming. Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop. Wait for trains to pass before you go.

questions.question: At a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Only yield to traffic on the right.
Only yield to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic pass.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and give the right-of-way to traffic in the intersection or roadway you are entering.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is low and may not fit tall vehicles.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge into one.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is low and may not fit tall vehicles.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet, 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.explanation: This sign is attached to slow-moving vehicles.
